requiredDobCopyTasks.printedLabel: My date of birth is / Mi fecha de nacimiento es
requiredDobCopyTasks.participantMustSupply: the DAY and the YEAR of your date of birth, in the second and third boxes under "My date of birth is / Mi fecha de nacimiento es" on page 11 of the Statement - copy them from the date of birth already printed on page 2 of the Statement
requiredDobCopyTasks.why: the three boxes on this line are one date and are completed together. Their month box shares an AcroForm field with the notary's month on page 12 and cannot be written without writing the notary's blank, so the whole line is left to the participant rather than delivered two-thirds filled

requiredDobCopyTasks.why: the three boxes on this line are one date and are completed together. Their month box shares an AcroForm field with the notary's month on page 12 and cannot be written without writing the notary's blank, so the whole line is left to the participant rather than delivered two-thirds filled

requiredDobCopyTasks.printedLabel: My date of birth is / Mi fecha de nacimiento es
requiredDobCopyTasks.participantMustSupply: the MONTH of your date of birth, in the first of the three boxes under "My date of birth is / Mi fecha de nacimiento es" on page 11 of the Statement - copy it from the date of birth already printed on page 2 of the Statement. The same form field is also the notary's month blank on page 12; leave that one for the notary
requiredDobCopyTasks.why: this box is one widget of an AcroForm field whose other widget is the notary's month on page 12, and this factory writes a field rather than a widget, so filling the birth month here would also print it in the notary's blank. The box is declared instead of forced, and the fact it needs is already printed on page 2 of the same document

protectedSigningAndNotaryDates.why: a date written before the Statement is actually sworn would be false
